decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk system draws directly on the firm's office furniture knowledge and benefits from rising demand for flexible workplaces, so the firm can interpret its results and keep refining it through in-house development.

The carpet floor cushions use the firm's material and upholstery expertise, but as a niche accessory line that has gone unobserved since 2019 they face a growing risk of being trimmed, so the line is kept under review.
The high standing table closely matches the firm's existing office and conference tables, so prior knowledge keeps it cheap to maintain and adapt for flexible meeting spaces.

The rug collection sits far from the firm's core knowledge, which limits how well it can learn from the results, but its flagship role and designer collaboration justify keeping it while the firm builds expertise in textiles.
